policy: Only public symbols from api/WisdomUI.api.json; no Sources/WisdomUI/Internal/**; no private Demo helpers; no design token values copied into provider cards.
labelPolicy: iOS parameter labels are preserved verbatim in card.signature; the former non-conformant iosLabel property is recorded in card.limitations as 'iOS label mapping: ...' because api-card.schema.json has additionalProperties:false.

baseline.staleNote: Provider snapshot is pinned to c3c32f3. iOS HEAD advanced to 64539fe (A-11/A-13/A-14) after capture, so the current api/WisdomUI.api.json no longer matches the pin. Cards were regenerated by replaying the pinned baseline snapshot; see ai/skill-provider/SNAPSHOT.md.

sourceRefs.api/WisdomUI.api.json: Canonical public symbol snapshot; source of every signature and overload.
sourceRefs.Package.swift: Deployment target, language mode, and product boundary.
sourceRefs.ai/skill-provider/SNAPSHOT.md: Snapshot provenance, stale declaration, replay and dist audit.

driftPolicy: Regenerate API cards only from the pinned baseline snapshot: python3 ai/skill-provider/api-cards/generate_api_cards.py --api <baseline api>/WisdomUI.api.json --out ai/skill-provider/api-cards . The generator fails on pin mismatch; the current HEAD API file is intentionally rejected until the provider is re-baselined.
